read_at_rule: Every time in this file is a fact about a past read. Nothing here states a cadence, a latency or a promise about the future.

status_vocabulary.verbatim: Exceed State standards for bacteria and may cause illness
WARNING – Avoid contact with ocean water due to sewage contamination or other health hazards
Not sampled due to inaccessibility, unsafe conditions, lab accident

san_diego.name: San Diego
san_diego.source_name: County of San Diego Department of Environmental Health
san_diego.refusal_reason: San Diego County publishes today's beach status at sdbeachinfo.com and on (619) 338-2073. This app does not read it. The county's map is served by an application that answers a scripted request with 405, or 403 without a browser session token, and this app does not build on endpoints a site gates that way. The county has been asked for a feed.

los_angeles.name: Los Angeles
los_angeles.source_name: Los Angeles County Department of Health Services
los_angeles.refusal_reason: Los Angeles County publishes today's beach status on its own map. This app does not read it: the map carries each beach's status only as a marker colour, and no legend for those colours is published on the page or in the map data. A meaning this app guessed would be a guess a reader could not check.

orange.name: Orange
orange.refusal_reason: Orange County publishes today's beach status at ocbeachinfo.com. This app does not read it: the site refuses scripted requests, including the request for its own robots file, so this app cannot establish that automated reading is permitted.

san_mateo.name: San Mateo
san_mateo.source_name: Health Department County of San Mateo Environmental Health
san_mateo.refusal_reason: San Mateo County publishes a beach map and the number above. This app does not read the map: it carries no date anywhere, so this app could not tell a reader how old a status is.

santa_cruz.name: Santa Cruz
santa_cruz.source_name: Santa Cruz County Environmental Health Service
santa_cruz.refusal_reason: Santa Cruz County publishes today's beach status on its own page and through a public map service. This app does not read it yet: the meanings of that service's own status values have not been confirmed, and this app does not ship a meaning it has not confirmed.

humboldt.name: Humboldt
humboldt.source_name: Humboldt County Health and Human Services Department Division of Environmental Health
humboldt.refusal_reason: Humboldt County publishes its beach sampling results and a posting line on its own page. This app does not read it yet.

sonoma.name: Sonoma
sonoma.source_name: County of Sonoma Health Services Environmental Health Division
sonoma.refusal_reason: Sonoma County publishes a per-beach status on its own page. This app does not read it yet.

san_francisco.name: San Francisco
san_francisco.source_name: San Francisco Department of Public Health
san_francisco.refusal_reason: San Francisco publishes beach sampling results as open data and runs a beach hotline. This app does not read a San Francisco status: the open dataset carries results rather than a posting, and the page that carries the postings has not been read by any lane.

santa_barbara.name: Santa Barbara
santa_barbara.source_name: Santa Barbara County Environmental Health Services
santa_barbara.refusal_reason: This app has not located Santa Barbara County's own beach-status channel. The map that search engines surface for this county is a personal project rather than the county's, and this app does not carry a health status from one.

monterey.name: Monterey
monterey.source_name: County of Monterey Department of Health Division of Environmental Health
monterey.refusal_reason: Monterey County publishes beach status on its own site. This app does not read it: the site refuses scripted requests with a 403 from its edge network.

marin.name: Marin
marin.source_name: County of Marin Environmental Health Services
marin.refusal_reason: Marin County publishes beach sampling on its own site. This app does not read it: the site refuses scripted requests with a 403. The state's own sampling, which this app already reads, is among the freshest in the state for Marin.

san_luis_obispo.name: San Luis Obispo
san_luis_obispo.source_name: San Luis Obispo County Public Health Department Environmental Health
san_luis_obispo.refusal_reason: This app does not read a San Luis Obispo county status. The state's own sampling, which this app already reads, covers the same 19 sites and was nine days old when this was written.

mendocino.name: Mendocino
mendocino.refusal_reason: No Mendocino County beach-status channel has been located, so this app reads none.

east_bay_parks_district.name: East Bay Parks District
east_bay_parks_district.refusal_reason: East Bay Regional Park District's own site is link-out only under this app's standing policy, permanently, so this app reads no status for these shorelines.

long_beach_city.name: Long Beach City
long_beach_city.source_name: City of Long Beach Health and Human Services
long_beach_city.refusal_reason: Long Beach runs its own city health department. This app has not located its beach-status channel, so it reads none.
